newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens denies rumours of capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Siemens denies rumours of capital rise.

text.p: German electronics group Siemens AG on Monday denied market rumours that the company planned to raise capital, saying it had no such plans.
"We are not planning any capital measures in the near term," a spokesman said in answer to Reuter enquiries.

Shares in Siemens AG on Monday climbed about five percent to a new record high, gaining from a positive analysts' meeting last week. In early electronic trading Siemens rose 5.90 marks to 130.40. The shares held their gains despite the capital rise rumours, closing at 130.45.
Siemens last Thursday presented its nine-month results to analysts. It reported net income rose three percent to 1.705 billion marks, even though it previously forecast no increase in 1996/97 profit.
